thread:
Sam - PMM: Need a compact one-pager (PDF) the field can send to technical buyers. Must include: security snapshot, SLA language (clear separation hosted vs dedicated), a short deploy decision flow, two benchmark callouts (latency and embeddings cost), and the inbound form routing rules. Prefer one sheet + tiny appendix.
Tori - Growth: Keep social/snackable lines we can reuse. I want one tweet, one LinkedIn blurb, and a single benchmark image.
Alex - Solutions: Propose non-committal SLA phrasing: 'Dedicated: contractual uptime and model-class latency SLOs. Hosted: operational baselines; contact us for enterprise SLAs.' Add a small "example metrics" box with caveats.
Ben - Field: Routing rules: if checkbox Gov/Fed/Regulated OR mentions 'on-prem' -> enterprise-sales; if 'pilot' or 'POC' -> AE; else -> growth-nurture. Add a 'compliance needs' free text field.
Lina - Design: I can do a tight single-column layout: Header + 3 tiles (Security, SLA & benchmarks, Deploy + routing). Need final copy by Thursday AM to mock.
Sam - PMM: Draft copy (to edit):
• Header: 'Enterprise Serving Snapshot — secure, predictable inference'
• Security tile (bullets): SOC2 Type II, customer KMS support, VPC peering, audit log export, optional on-prem air-gapped bundle.
• SLA tile: 'Dedicated: contractual uptime and latency SLOs. Hosted: published baselines; Dedicated recommended for SLAs.' Link to appendix for numbers.
Alex - Solutions: Appendix examples (label: sample measurements, not guarantees):
- Chat (redwood-7b-v1, 512 tokens): p50 ~ 85ms, p95 ~ 320ms on Dedicated (A100).
- Embeddings (batch=256, int8 + prefix cache): throughput ~ 20k embeddings/hr, est cost/unit $0.0009.
Caveat line: 'Measured on standard Dedicated hardware; actuals vary by model, length, and region.'
Ben - Field: Buyer-facing compliance lines (short): 'We support KMS/HSM, audit export, and can deploy on-prem for air-gapped requirements. Enterprise routing for GovCloud/FedRAMP via sales.'
Tori - Growth: Webinar plan: 20-min talk + 10-min Q&A. Title suggestion: 'Serving LLMs for regulated teams: performance & controls.' CTA: download one-pager + appendix. Lina can we include a CTA button that opens the inbound form?
Lina - Design: Yes. Proposed form fields: name, company, email, region, workload type (chat/embeddings/other), compliance checkbox(es), pilot timeline, needs on-prem (checkbox), hidden routing tags.
ops-bot: New draft asset created -> https://redwood.internal/marketing/enterprise-serving-snapshot-draft (edit access).
Sam - PMM: Action items:
- Alex: paste final appendix metrics + 1-2 CLI snippets for ops demo (tomorrow)
- Lina: deliver first PDF mock (Thu AM)
- Tori: draft webinar landing + social copy (Thu)
- Ben: confirm routing rules with inbound ops (next week)
Sam - PMM: Keep language concise so field can forward directly to buyers. We'll iterate numbers in the appendix only. Thanks! :rocket:
